posts.title: A Short History of the Information Age
posts.description: The Information Age, just 80 years old, transformed society through digital technology. Originating with the ENIAC computer in 1945, inventions of the Information Age, like the transistor and World Wide Web, have reshaped the world.

posts.title: Roger Bacon and the Art of Grant Proposal Writing
posts.description: Science is an invention, neither natural nor obvious. And Roger Bacon in the 13th century, writing one of the first grant proposals, was proposing to invent it.

posts.title: The Best Physics of the Century (So Far)
posts.description: The century is now a quarter over. What are the greatest discoveries in physics so far? What comes next?
